G4709:

G4711: * σφυρίς (T, Rec. σπυρίς, v. WH, App., 148; Bl., § 6, 7), -ίδος, ἡ, a flexible mat-basket for carrying provisions: Matthew 15:37 Matthew 16:10, Mark 8:8, Mark 8:20 Acts 9:25 (v.s. κόφινος).†
G4712:

G4713: στάμνος, -ου (ὁ and), ἡ [in LXX: Exodus 16:33 (צִנְצֶנֶת), 1 Kings 12:24 1 Kings 14:3 (בַּקְבֻּק), Da LXX Bel 32 * ;] prop., an earthen jar for racking off wine, hence, generally, a jar: Hebrews 9:4.†
G4714:
στάσις, -εως, ἡ (< ἵστημι), [in LXX chiefly for עמד, its parts and derivatives, also for רִיב (Proverbs 17:14), etc. (v. Deiss., BS, 158 f.) ;]

G4716:

σταυρόω, -ῶ (< σταυρός), [in LXX: Esther 7:9 (תּלה), Esther 8:13 * ;]

G4719: στάχυς, -υος, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for שִׁבֹּלֶת ;] an ear of corn: Matthew 12:1, Mark 2:23 Mark 4:28, Luke 6:1.†
G4720: στάχυς, -υος, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for שִׁבֹּלֶת ;] an ear of corn: Matthew 12:1, Mark 2:23 Mark 4:28, Luke 6:1.†
G4721: στέγη, -ης, ἡ (< στέγω) [in LXX: Genesis 8:13 (מִכְסֶה), etc. ;] a roof: Mark 2:4; of entering a house, εἰσέρχεσθαι ὑπὸ τὴν σ., Matthew 8:8, Luke 7:6 (cf. MM, xxiii).†
G4722:
** στέγω (cf. Lat. tego), [in LXX: Si 8:17 * ;]
1. prop., to cover closely, to protect by covering, esp. to keep water in or out (Soph., Plat., al.).
2. to cover, keep secret, conceal (Si, l.c., Polyb., al.): 1 Corinthians 13:7, R, mg.

G4723: στεῖρος, -ον also -α, -ον, [in LXX for עֲקֶרֶת, עֲקָרָה ;] barren: of a woman, Luke 1:7, Luke 1:36 Luke 23:29, Galatians 4:27 (LXX).†

G4725: * στέμμα, -τος, τό (< στέφω, to put around, enwreath) a wreath, garland: as used in sacrifices, Acts 14:13.†
G4726: στεναγμός, -οῦ, ὁ (< στενάζω), [in LXX for אֲנָחָה, אֲנָקָה, נְאָקָה, etc. ;] a groaning: Acts 7:34 (LXX κραυγή), Romans 8:26.†

G4728: στενός, -ή, -όν [in LXX for צַר, etc. ;] narrow: fig (v MM, xxiii), Matthew 7:13-14, Luke 13:24.†

G4747:

G4753:

G4756:
